verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export, including scheduled automated full exports. Exports are Markdown with properties converted to front matter, and collections are stored as CSV. The docs describe the output as human- and machine-readable and easy to reuse in other apps, which directly supports exporting everything in open formats and leaving. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that full exports are complete and portable, and explicit documentation of how media/files and links are represented in the export.
